title: MDungeons Paintings Resource Pack
description: Resourcepack for datapack which adds paintings from Minecraft Dungeons to Minecraft
body:
This resourcepack is necessary for the correct work of datapack, which adds 79 paintings from Minecraft Dungeons most of which are portraits of developers from the titles of the game. It includes paintings are presented in sizes:
- 1x1 — 2 paintings
- 2x1 — 1 painting
- 2x2 — 6 paintings
- 2x3 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)
- 3x2 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)
- 2x4 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)
- 3x3 — 58 paintings
- 4x4 — 1 painting
- 16x9 — 7 paintings (new minecraft painting size)
- 11x16 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)

It will only work in those worlds where a [datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minecraft-dungeons-paintings-data-pack) is installed for it.
